projects.title: Dynamic Developer Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Developer Portfolio Website built in React and Vite for Aditya Zalavadiya (AZ).
 - Fully customisable, dynamic Markdown rendering, and reactive bento grid UI architecture.
 - Integrated Dark & Light Mode theme toggling.

projects.title: Caaring - Cab Share App
projects.bodyText:
- A real-time cab sharing web application built using **Django** and Python.
 - Features automated user authentication and secure password recovery mechanisms.
 - Designed for transit efficiency, collaborative journeys, and scalable server deployments.

projects.title: Quiet Hours - Android Automation
projects.bodyText:
- An Android productivity application that **automatically silences** your phone during scheduled hours and important meetings.
 - Option to schedule custom class **slots** and **custom time frames**.
 - Supports intelligent profile switching between Silent and Vibrate modes.

projects.title: Secure Chat App
projects.bodyText:
- An encrypted real-time Android communication app designed for confidential messaging.
 - Implements end-to-end cryptographic protection utilizing the **RSA Encryption Algorithm**.
 - Powered by a cloud **Firebase** realtime database and protected by biometric **Fingerprint authentication**.

projects.title: MVVM Sample Architecture App
projects.bodyText:
- An Android mobile application demonstrating modern enterprise engineering practices with mock API data feeds.
 - Robust offline synchronization powered by **Room DB** and **NetworkBoundResource**.
 - Architected using structured **MVVM**, **Kotlin Coroutines**, **Flow**, and **Hilt-Dagger** dependency injection.

projects.title: Paginated Feeds List App
projects.bodyText:
- A responsive Android mobile frontend designed to fetch, display, and scroll large paginated API data feeds inside an optimized RecyclerView.
 - Implements the clean **MVVM** design architecture.
 - Integrates Android's **Paging 3** architecture library alongside reactive Kotlin Coroutines & Flow streams.
